goal: Prevent privacy network peers from correlating a node's clearnet and privacy identities
Stop leaking custom listening ports across Tor and I2P when peers report spoofed local addresses
agreement: Broad support with no open objections (jonatack, mzumsande, darosior, w0xlt, danielabrozzoni)
Clarified that CJDNS does not need this handling and resolved a code comment issue (0xB10C, mzumsande)

categories.name: p2p
why: P2 because it fixes an address leak that could link clearnet and privacy network identities
Prevents adversaries on Tor or I2P from learning a node's custom clearnet listening port
